name: Send Weekly Analytics Comparison to Email and Telegram

parameters.jsCode:
function dates({propertyId,recipient,chatId}){if(!/^\d+$/.test(propertyId)||typeof recipient!=='string'||!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(recipient)||typeof chatId!=='string'||!chatId||chatId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure property, email and Telegram chat');const today=new Date(),iso=d=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10),end=new Date(Date.UTC(today.getUTCFullYear(),today.getUTCMonth(),today.getUTCDate()-1)),start=new Date(end.getTime()-6*86400000),year=d=>{let x=new Date(d);x.setUTCFullYear(x.getUTCFullYear()-1);return x};const priorEnd=year(end),priorStart=new Date(priorEnd.getTime()-6*86400000);return {propertyId,recipient,chatId,recentStart:iso(start),recentEnd:iso(end),previousStart:iso(priorStart),previousEnd:iso(priorEnd)}}

return [{json:dates({propertyId:'YOUR_PROPERTY_ID',recipient:'report@example.com',chatId:'configured-separately'})}];

const r=$input.first().json.body, rows=r?.rows??[],count=r?.rowCount??(rows.length===0?0:null);if(!r||!Array.isArray(rows)||!Number.isInteger(count)||count!==rows.length||count>8)throw Error('Invalid analytics report');const a=Array(8).fill(0);for(const row of rows){if(!Array.isArray(row.dimensionValues)||!/^\d{8}$/.test(row.dimensionValues[0]?.value)||!Array.isArray(row.metricValues)||row.metricValues.length!==8)throw Error('Invalid analytics row');row.metricValues.forEach((x,i)=>{const n=Number(x.value);if(typeof x.value!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(n))throw Error('Invalid metric');a[i]+=n})}for(const i of [3,4,6])if(rows.length)a[i]/=rows.length;return [{json:{sum_Aufrufe:a[0],sum_Nutzer:a[1],sum_Sitzungen:a[2],average_Sitzungen_pro_Nutzer:a[3],average_Sitzungsdauer:a[4],sum_Käufe:a[5],average_Revenue_pro_Kauf:a[6],sum_Revenue:a[7]},pairedItem:{item:0}}];

| Metrics | Last 7 days | Previous year | Percentage change |
|-------------------------------|---------------|---------|
| Total page views | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Aufrufe }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Aufrufe }} | Percentage change |

| Average sessions/user | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Sitzungen_pro_Nutzer }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Sitzungen_pro_Nutzer }} | Percentage change |
| Average session duration | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Sitzungsdauer }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Sitzungsdauer }} | Percentage change |
| Total purchases | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json['sum_Käufe'] }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json['sum_Käufe'] }} | Percentage change |
| Average revenue/purchase | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Revenue_pro_Kauf }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Revenue_pro_Kauf }} | Percentage change |
| Total revenue | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Revenue }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Revenue }} | Percentage change |

Format for numbers:
- Dot (.) for numbers in thousands (e.g. 4,000)
- Comma (,) for decimal numbers (e.g. 3.4)
- Conversion of average session duration in minutes instead of seconds
- Average turnover/purchase and total turnover in the property reporting currency, without adding a currency symbol

Please write a short summary of the analyzed data above the table (in a maximum of 3 sentences!)

Please format to a sleek and modern HTML format so that the result can be sent as HTML mail!

Structure of the e-mail:

“Hello! Here is the Weekly Report: Google Analytics of the last 7 days!
[Summary]
[Table]”
